subject: bombardier beetle
title: This Beetle Shoots Boiling Spray and Doesn't Burn Itself

scenes.text: This beetle shoots boiling liquid, and it never burns itself.
A bombardier beetle mixes hydrogen peroxide and hydroquinones in a chamber full of enzymes.
The reaction makes a spray near 100 degrees Celsius, the temperature water boils.
It fires in pulses, hundreds every second, and reflector plates on its abdomen aim the spray.
Those pauses give the chamber time to cool, and its walls are reinforced with chitin and wax.
It isn't fireproof. It's firing hundreds of tiny blasts a second.

description:
The bombardier beetle sprays a liquid close to 100 degrees Celsius at attackers.
It mixes chemicals inside a reinforced chamber, and fires in rapid pulses, hundreds a second, so the chamber can cool between bursts.
Reflector plates on its abdomen direct the spray.
Which animal's defence would you steal? Tell us below.
